comment: Catalog of MakeMKV settings.conf keys that Bromelia exposes. Shared by the macOS, Windows and Linux front-ends. Values are always written as strings, exactly as MakeMKV stores them.

settings.label: Data directory
settings.help: Folder where MakeMKV keeps its downloaded data (SDF, hashed keys, KEYDB.cfg). Leave empty to use MakeMKV's default. Bromelia shares your normal MakeMKV data folder with every drive unless you override it here.

settings.label: Expert mode
settings.help: Enables advanced MakeMKV behaviour and additional information in logs.

settings.label: Log debug messages
settings.help: Makes makemkvcon emit DEBUG messages and write MakeMKV_log.txt.

settings.label: Show AV synchronization messages
settings.help: Report every audio/video synchronization fix-up while ripping.

settings.label: Check for MakeMKV updates
settings.help: Allow makemkvcon to contact makemkv.com to check for updates.

settings.label: Proxy server
settings.help: HTTP proxy used by MakeMKV for internet access, for example http://proxy:3128.

settings.label: Message language
settings.help: Language makemkvcon uses for log and progress messages (ISO 639-2 code, e.g. eng). Empty = automatic.

settings.label: Preferred audio/subtitle language
settings.help: Used by the 'favlang' token in selection rules (ISO 639-2 code, e.g. eng, fra, jpn).

settings.label: Read retry count
settings.help: How many times a failed read is retried before MakeMKV gives up on a sector. Empty = MakeMKV default.

settings.label: Read buffer size (MB)
settings.help: Size of the read cache. Larger values help slow or error-prone drives.

settings.label: Ignore read errors
settings.help: Continue past unreadable sectors instead of failing the title.

settings.label: Single drive mode
settings.help: Advanced MakeMKV IO option.

settings.label: macOS kernel workaround
settings.help: Advanced MakeMKV IO option for macOS drive access.

settings.label: Minimum title length (seconds)
settings.help: Titles shorter than this are hidden from the disc listing.

settings.label: Structure protection removal
settings.help: Algorithm MakeMKV uses to remove fake cells on protected DVDs.

settings.label: Java executable
settings.help: Path to a Java runtime used for BD-J based protections. Empty = autodetect.

settings.label: Always dump BD+ information
settings.help: Write BD+ diagnostic dumps for every disc.

settings.label: CCExtractor executable
settings.help: Path to ccextractor, used to extract closed captions (EIA-608) into subtitle tracks.

settings.label: Default profile name
settings.help: Name of the MakeMKV profile used when no profile file is passed. Bromelia normally passes an explicit per-drive profile.

settings.label: Default selection rule
settings.help: Rule deciding which tracks are included in every MKV. Empty = the profile's rule.

settings.label: Output file name template
settings.help: MakeMKV's own file naming template, e.g. {NAME1}{_t:INDEX}. Bromelia can additionally rename files after ripping.

settings.label: Decrypt video files in backups by default
settings.help: Default for the 'decrypt' option of backups.
